title: legal_hold.status_changed event payload (v1)
description: PACK-09, ADR-039. Produced by epd2_compliance_service.events. Minimum payload only: identifiers, enum values, timestamps and reason codes. It never carries a document or its bytes, a ballot/vote/tally/delegation reference, an authentication secret, an identity/eID/KYC attribute, a free-text case narrative, or the name of any natural person (PACK-09 required invariants 1, 11, 12 and 13). Shared verbatim by the three actions a hold's lifecycle has: issued, released and marked_indeterminate. scope_record_count is a COUNT, not the list of covered record ids, so a hold's coverage is not broadcast.
